title: CLI Commands
summary: This module defines and implements the command-line interface (CLI) commands for interacting with the application, including running models, managing integrations, and handling server operations.

nodes.label: Run Server
nodes.title: Run Server

nodes.label: Launch Interactive Model
nodes.title: Launch Interactive Model
nodes.description: Handles the interactive execution of a model, including model loading, capability inference, and generating responses.

nodes.label: Run Embedding Model
nodes.title: Run Embedding Model
nodes.description: Processes requests to generate embeddings for text input, supporting various flags and input methods.

nodes.label: Handle Cloud Stub Pull
nodes.title: Handle Cloud Stub Pull

nodes.label: Push Model Handler

nodes.label: Integration Launchers

nodes.title: Configuration Management
